title: Fantastic Biases (What are They) and Where to Find Them

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in input text to measure changes in model outputs, such as testing if a sentiment analysis system changes its predictions based on names from different countries.

Analyzing the positiveness of system outputs (e.g., predicting higher recidivism for Black individuals) and evaluating heterogeneous performance metrics like false positive and false negative rates across subgroups (e.g., evaluating facial recognition accuracy).
Analyzing the positiveness of output predictions over target groups, such as testing if employability predictions are systematically lower for females.
Prompting language models to act like personas from specific political sides to see if they replicate the viewpoints and ideologies of demographically varied subpopulations.
Evaluating model alignment with human beliefs, norms, and customs from different groups, and tracking the amplification of existing cultural prejudices and stereotypes in model outputs.
